Starter drunken chicken was cold and inedible however main courses were better. When we went to pay the server insisted my husband sign up to Marriott to get a discount, however this was a long process and seems to be part of their role as quite insistent. Has to be tons of other better Cantonese restaurants in HCMC so I would give this a miss
